page.layout: One page of text, with a diagram (a globe divided into zones) in the middle; a figure caption below the diagram; a catchword-like signature "QVAR" at the lower right. No margin notes. A digitiser's link at the foot is left out.

main_text.l: eorum velut in orbem circumagantur in plano terræ. Non
enim rectos, non obliquos, sed Horizonti Paralle-
los radios ad ea loca Sol transmittit, qui
ut in infinitum excurrunt, sic umbras, in planum
terræ procumbentes, & in infinitum extensas gignunt.

page.notes: The diagram's zone labels are partly rendered in the figure; the Greek word at the start of the first line is printed as "περίσκιοι" (perhaps περίσκιοι). The "TROP." labels and zodiac signs are only approximately readable. "QVAR" is a catchword-like mark, uncertain as to its full form. The running text of the caption is set in a larger type.
